expected.subject: openlobby.core.search.*
expected.justification: ADR-0002: 'We will use Elasticsearch. It's well known database with great fulltext search capabilities based on Apache Lucene.' The 'database for all data' clause is content-superseded by ADR-0011: 'Elasticsearch will be used for denormalized reports and related data intended for fulltext search.' Post-resolution, ADR-0002's live mandate is Elasticsearch for fulltext search, whose locus is the search code (#125: post-resolution gold reading).

expected.subject: openlobby.core.api.*
expected.justification: ADR-0004 mandates GraphQL as the API standard, implemented via Graphene library

expected.subject: openlobby.core.api.*
expected.justification: ADR-0004 mandates GraphQL over REST; REST API frameworks should not be used

expected.subject: openlobby.*
expected.justification: ADR-0006 mandates Flask as the web framework; superseded by ADR-0010

expected.subject: openlobby.core.api.*
expected.justification: ADR-0007 mandates adopting GraphQL Relay specification for pagination and Node interface via Graphene Relay

expected.subject: openlobby.core.openid.*
expected.justification: ADR-0009 mandates OpenID Connect for user authentication; openlobby/core/openid.py imports the oic package

expected.subject: openlobby.*
expected.justification: ADR-0010 prohibits Flask; it is replaced by Django

expected.subject: openlobby.core.models.*
expected.justification: ADR-0010 mandates Django as the web framework; relational data access goes through the Django ORM (django.db). Moved from ADR-0011 since the Django ORM choice is what makes django.db the access path.

expected.subject: openlobby.core.search.*
expected.justification: ADR-0011 relegates Elasticsearch to denormalized reports and fulltext search, not as primary database

expected.justification: ADR-0012 prohibits MySQL/MariaDB due to ACID-breaking bug in schema changes
